chapterInfo.content:
5
Ahemman mmienu no atenetene
1Montie yei, asɔfoɔ,
na monwɛn aso, Israel fie,
na ɔhene fie nso, monyɛ aso;
na mo so na atemmuo aba;
na moadane fidie wɔ Mispa
ne asau a wɔatrɛ mu wɔ Tabor so.
2Na mansotwefoɔ ama wɔn ahohwisɛmdie mu adɔ,
nanso mɛtwe wɔn nyinaa aso.
3 # Hos 1.2 Me deɛ, menim Efraim,
na Israel nso nhunta me;
na afei, Efraim, woabɔ adwaman,
na Israel ho agu fi.
4 # Hos 4.12 Wɔn nneyɛɛ mma
wɔnsane mma wɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,
na adwamammɔ honhom wɔ wɔn mu,
na wɔnnim AWURADE.
5Na Israel ahantan bɛdi n’anim adanseɛ,
na Israel ne Efraim bɛsunti wɔn amumuyɛ mu;
Yuda nso ne wɔn asunti.
6 # Yes 1.11-15 Wɔde wɔn nnwan ne wɔn anantwie bɛkɔ
akɔhwehwɛ AWURADE,
na wɔrenhu no;
ɛfiri sɛ, watwe ne ho afiri wɔn ho.
7Wɔatwa AWURADE nkontompo,
na wɔawowo ananafoɔ mma.
Afei bosome foforɔ bɛmene wɔn ne wɔn nsase.
8 # Hos 4.15 Monhyɛne abɛn Gibea,
monhyɛne totorobɛnto Rama.
Mommɔ ose Bet-awen,
ɛwɔ w’akyi, Benyamin.
9Efraim bɛdane amamfo,
asotwe da no;
mama wɔahunu Israel mmusuakuo
ho asɛm a ɛbɛtim mu.
10Yuda mmapɔmma ayɛ sɛ
wɔn a wɔtwe ɛhyeɛ kɔ akyire,
wɔn so na mɛhwie
m’anibereɛ magu sɛ nsuo.
11 # Yes 29.13 Wɔhyɛ Efraim so, wɔapɛkyɛ no atemmuo mu,
ɛfiri sɛ waboapa adi n’ahuhudeɛ akyi.
12Na me deɛ, mete sɛ nweweboaa mema Efraim
ne nhunhuniiɛ mema Yuda fie.
13 # Hos 7.11; 10.6 Na Efraim hunuu ne yadeɛ,
na Yuda hunuu ne kuro;
na Efraim sii mu kɔɔ Asiria,
na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ Ɔhene Yareb nkyɛn;
na ɔno nso, ɔrentumi nsa mo yadeɛ,
na ɔrentumi nkum mo ho akuro.
14 # Hos 13.7; 6.1 Na me deɛ, mete sɛ ɛserɛ-mu-sɛe ma Efraim
ne gyataburuwa ma Yuda fie;
me, me na mɛtete mu makorɔ,
mɛfa makɔ a ɔgyefoɔ biara nni hɔ.
15 # Yes 26.16 Mɛkɔ, mɛsane makɔ baabi,
akɔsi sɛ ɛbɛka wɔn ani na wɔabɛhwehwɛ m’anim;
wɔn ho hiahia wɔn a, wɔbɛhwehwɛ me ntɛm.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
